card.name: Missed dose instructions
card.fires_on: The word "missed" in missed-dose instructions, and "up" in "make up" for a missed dose or quiz. It fires where the text is about skipped doses or sessions.

modes.label: The word missed
modes.description: "missed" right after "is", "the" or "make up", in missed-dose directions.

modes.label: Make up
modes.description: "up" in "make up" for something that was skipped.
modes.example: Do not take 2 doses at the same time to make<< up>> for a missed dose.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about missed or interrupted things, such as "missed" and "interrupted".
card.plain: It lights up on the wording about what to do when a dose or session was missed.
